data.command: Tell me about your network configuration

data.text:
Our network configuration is pretty standard, but I'll give you the lowdown. We're running a dual-homed setup with a mix of wired and wireless connections.

On the wired side, we've got a 10GbE switch connected to our core router, which is a Cisco ASA 5506-X. It's configured to route traffic between our internal 10.0.0.0/8 subnet and our public IP on 203.0.113.100. I've also got a static IP for our DNS server, which is running on 10.0.0.10.

For wireless, we've got a Ruckus R730i access point on 10.0.0.20, broadcasting our network as "LinuxLab" on 5GHz. We use WPA2 security with a pre-shared key, and our passkey is stored in /etc/wpa_supplicant.conf. I should probably update that to use a more secure password, but it's been working so far...

As for firewalls, I've got UFW (Uncomplicated Firewall) set up to block incoming traffic on most ports, but we do have a few open for our web server on port 80 (Apache) and SSH on port
